{{Top|leg}}
A '''hemodialysis pump''' was a device that was used to pump blood into a needing [[Sentience/Legends|being]]. The pump was designed to be portable, and consisted of a flat shoulder pack that was able to contain six liters of fresh [[Blood/Legends|blood]], as well as a vacuum tube system. [[Darth Scabrous]] used one of these to pump uninfected blood into his system to hold off [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|the Sickness]], until he could ingest the heart of a powerful [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].
